faqs.q1: How do I find workers near me?
faqs.a1: Use the search feature on the Home page. Set your filters and swipe to search.
faqs.a2: Our system connects you with nearby workers or jobs based on your search criteria and location.
faqs.a3: Yes, drag the stop slider on the searching screen to cancel anytime.
faqs.a4: You can reach us through the Contact Us option in this Help section.
